teaser.en: The stems of this grass help make the *kayamba*, the shaken rattle that keeps rhythm at coastal dances.
teaser.sw: Mashina ya nyasi hii husaidia kutengeneza *kayamba*, kayamba linalotikiswa kushika mdundo katika ngoma za pwani.

summary.en: *Mchuchi* is the name for the tall thatching grasses of grassland and fallow. It thatches roofs and supplies stems for the *kayamba* rattle.
summary.sw: *Mchuchi* ni jina la nyasi ndefu za kuezekea za nyika na mashamba yaliyoachwa. Huezeka paa na hutoa mashina ya kutengeneza kayamba, *kayamba*.

about.en:
*Mchuchi* is a group of tall, tufted grasses that grow in dense clumps. Their flowering heads are distinctive: the spikelets come in pairs, each pair wrapped in a leaf-like sheath, giving the top of the stem a ragged, layered look.

As they dry, the grasses turn a warm reddish brown, which is where the English name 'red grass' comes from.
about.sw:
*Mchuchi* ni kundi la nyasi ndefu zinazoota kwa vichaka vizito. Vishada vyake vya maua vina sura ya pekee: vichanua huja kwa jozi, kila jozi ikiwa imefungwa ndani ya ala kama jani, na kuipa ncha ya shina sura chakavu yenye matabaka.

Zinapokauka, nyasi hizi hugeuka kuwa za rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu, na ndiko jina la Kiingereza *red grass* linakotoka.

where.en: Look for *mchuchi* in grassland and on fallow land. It is easiest to recognise late in the season, when the stands turn red-brown.
where.sw: Mtafute *mchuchi* katika nyika na kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa. Ni rahisi zaidi kuutambua mwishoni mwa msimu, vichaka vyake vinapogeuka kahawia-nyekundu.

uses.en:
*Mchuchi* is cut for thatch, the long, tough stems laid in layers on roofs.

Its stems are also used to make the *kayamba*, the flat rattle of reed stems filled with seeds that is shaken to keep rhythm in coastal music.
uses.sw:
*Mchuchi* hukatwa kwa ajili ya kuezekea, mashina yake marefu na magumu yakipangwa kwa matabaka juu ya paa.

Mashina yake pia hutumika kutengeneza *kayamba*, kayamba bapa la mashina ya matete lililojazwa mbegu ambalo hutikiswa kushika mdundo katika muziki wa pwani.

names.en: Digo: *mchuchi*, also *mdembe*. Note that *mdembe* is also the name of a different thatching grass (*Hyperthelia dissoluta*). English: thatching grass or red grass. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists place it in the genus *Hyparrhenia*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mchuchi*, pia *mdembe*. Ifahamike kuwa *mdembe* pia ni jina la nyasi nyingine ya kuezekea (*Hyperthelia dissoluta*). Kwa Kiingereza: *thatching grass* au *red grass*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huiweka katika jenasi *Hyparrhenia*.

reason.en: Another thatching grass, sharing the name mdembe
reason.sw: Nyasi nyingine ya kuezekea, inayoshiriki jina mdembe

reason.en: Tall grass of the same grassland and fallow
reason.sw: Nyasi ndefu ya nyika na mashamba yale yale yaliyoachwa

reason.en: Doum palm, another thatching and craft plant
reason.sw: Mkoma, mmea mwingine wa kuezekea na wa ufundi

reason.en: Coconut palm, the main source of makuti thatch
reason.sw: Mnazi, chanzo kikuu cha makuti ya kuezekea
